data.name: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
data.detailed_description:
◼︎Grow stronger. Break the battlefield.

Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush is a Japanese dark fantasy survivor-style roguelite where you cut through hordes of yokai, choose and upgrade skills, and push them beyond their limits.

Even a small attack can grow stronger as you keep fighting.
With every upgrade, your attacks expand, intensify, and eventually become powerful enough to overwhelm the entire battlefield.

Defeat enemies.
Choose your skills.
Grow stronger.
Then use that power to wipe out the battlefield.

Experience the satisfaction of becoming stronger and defeating more enemies with every run.

◼︎Master 14 skills and carve through hordes of yokai

When you level up during battle, you can choose from multiple skills to strengthen your build.

The skills you choose will change your attack range, your fighting style, and the way you defeat enemies.

A simple attack can grow into something far more devastating as you level it up.
The more enemies you defeat, the easier it becomes to tear through the next wave.

Choose your skills, shape your build, and break through the yokai horde.

◼︎Break your skills beyond their limits

By upgrading your skills and meeting certain conditions, you can unlock powerful Limit Break skills.

Limit Break skills are on a completely different scale from normal attacks, unleashing enough power to reshape the battlefield.

Feel the rush of reaching the next stage of power and blowing away hordes with a single overwhelming attack.

◼︎Turn the tide with a special attack

During battle, you can also unleash Kocho’s special attack.

A Live2D animation flows directly into gameplay, leading into a powerful strike that wipes out enemies in front of you.

Even when you are surrounded, a special attack can turn the battle around in an instant.

◼︎Defeat powerful foes and claim your rewards

At the end of each stage, powerful yokai bosses await.

Use the skills you have raised, Limit Break attacks, and special attacks to defeat them.

Beyond victory, rewards await.

Defeating a boss is not the end.
The rewards you earn become the beginning of your next stage of growth.

◼︎Fuse the gear you earn and make it stronger

The gear you obtain from boss rewards and other battles can be strengthened through fusion.

By upgrading your gear, your stats increase, allowing you to take on even stronger enemies.

Which gear will you upgrade?
Which power will you strengthen?
Your choices directly shape your strength in the next battle.

Turn the rewards you earn into even greater power.

◼︎Change your gear. Change your look and your fighting style.

Kocho can equip different fans, hairstyles, kimono, obi, hair accessories, and more.

Changing gear alters her appearance while also improving her stats and normal attacks.

Fans come in multiple attributes, including Normal, Ice, Fire, Wind, and Water.
The fan you equip changes both the look of your attacks and how you fight.

Dress Kocho in your favorite gear and challenge the yokai horde with your own fighting style.

◼︎Upgrade your gear and face even stronger foes

By strengthening your gear, choosing attributes, and preparing your build, you can challenge even more dangerous enemy hordes.

Freeze enemies with ice.
Burn them with fire.
Wash across the battlefield with water.

The stronger you become, the more enemies you can defeat.
But the enemies will continue to grow stronger as well.

Gather rewards, upgrade your gear, and keep pushing deeper to defeat the next powerful foe.

◼︎Choose your gear for each stage and challenge it again and again

In normal stages, the stage attribute is decided at the start.

Fire, Ice, Wind, Water, and other attributes can change from stage to stage.
Choose gear that matches the stage attribute before heading into battle, and each run will create a different way to fight.

Which gear will you bring?
Which skills will you raise?
Which rewards will you choose?

Every battle changes your choices, and every choice changes how Kocho grows.

In addition to normal stages, survival-style stages focused on earning rewards in a short amount of time are also planned.

Higher difficulty stages will offer greater rewards, but the enemy attacks will become more intense.

Defeating enemies matters.
Surviving long enough to claim your rewards matters just as much.

A tale of revenge begins

Kocho, the protagonist, once had a peaceful life.

But that peace was stolen by yokai.

After losing someone precious to her and falling into despair, Kocho receives power from a divine dragon.

Why does she fight?
Why must she continue to grow stronger?

The answers will slowly unfold through her story of revenge.

◼︎After fierce battles, spend quiet moments with Kocho

Between battles, quiet moments await in the pleasure quarter, where you can spend time with Kocho.

By talking with her, giving her gifts, and deepening your bond, Kocho’s expressions and attitude will gradually change.

On the battlefield, she cuts down hordes of yokai.
Away from battle, she may reveal a gentler, more delicate side.

The thrill of intense combat.
The quiet comfort of spending time with Kocho.

That contrast is another core appeal of Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush.

◼︎Key Features

  • A high-density Japanese dark fantasy survivor-like action game where you play as the protagonist, Kochou, and wipe out hordes of yokai

  • A combat system where you choose from 14 skills, grow stronger, and evolve them into Limit Break (MAX)

  • Limit Break skills and deadly dances that annihilate huge numbers of enemies at once

  • Strengthen Kochou by combining weapons, kimono, obi, hairstyles, hair ornaments, and more

  • Tactical combat that changes depending on the yokai’s 9 elements and how you switch gear, elements, and resistances

  • Live2D-driven presentation and expressive character animation

  • A deeper relationship with Kochou through conversations and gifts

  • Fast-paced roguelite progression with each stage lasting around 13 minutes

  • A story about a heroine who carries revenge and its cost, fighting beautifully as she slowly breaks apart

◼︎World

Behind the alluring pleasure quarters lies a ritual of yokai and blood.
A dark fantasy world where Japanese beauty and decay intertwine.

Every time the oiran dances, blood stains the night.

Supported Languages

  • Japanese

  • English

  • Simplified Chinese

  • Traditional Chinese

Controls

  • Keyboard & Mouse

  • Gamepad

Voice Cast

  • Narration: Kouko Tsukimoto

  • Kochou (Character Voice): Akiko Tani

Voice Production / Casting Support

  • Artist Crew Co., Ltd.

data.short_description: Defeat, choose, grow, and break the battlefield. A Japanese dark fantasy survivor-style roguelite where you Limit Break 14 skills and cut down hordes of yokai. Defeat bosses, forge gear from their rewards, and face even stronger foes.
data.supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese*, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1920×1080 resolution, Normal graphics settings, and 60 FPS.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU or better, Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes:
